description: Three-path logo (interlocking swash forms) with flowing gradient animation. The canonical fill is teal-mint #3cc194. Two animated linearGradients sweep across the logo form — grad-flow rotates continuously, grad-shimmer breathes vertically. A feGaussianBlur glow filter adds luminous halo depth. The palette stays within the teal-cyan-jade arc with slight warm-aqua drift allowed for artistic variation.

palette_groups.note: Three-stop animated gradient cycling through teal, cyan-jade, and deep aqua. Anchored at color-a (canonical mint #3cc194). color-b shifts cooler/cyan, color-c dips into deep teal-jade. Low-medium entropy — stays within the teal-cyan arc. glow-color is anchored here for filter coherence.

motion_groups.note: Full rotation period of grad-flow gradient transform around the logo center. Slower = more stately, faster = energetic churn.
Period of the stop-color animate cycle on grad-flow and grad-shimmer. Controls how fast hues transition between color-a/b/c.
Opacity breath animation on Path 3 (the large body form). Slow inhale/exhale giving the logo a living quality.

vars.name: color-a
vars.note: Gradient stop 0% — canonical teal-mint anchor. Maps to original #3cc194.

vars.name: color-b
vars.note: Gradient stop 50% — cooler cyan-aqua. Provides the mid-sweep luminance shift.

vars.name: color-c
vars.note: Gradient stop 100% — deeper teal-jade. Adds shadow depth to gradient tail.

vars.name: glow-color
vars.note: feFlood color inside glow-filter. Anchored to flow palette — keeps halo coherent with fill animation.

vars.name: blur-glow
vars.note: feGaussianBlur stdDeviation for glow filter. Lower = sharper crisp halo; higher = soft ambient bloom.

vars.name: opacity-glow
vars.note: flood-opacity of the glow feFlood. Controls glow intensity — higher values push saturation.

vars.name: opacity-primary
vars.note: Base opacity for Path 1 and Path 2 (the wing forms). Static — no animation.

vars.name: opacity-body
vars.note: Base opacity for Path 3 (large body form). Also used as animate from/to value for the breath cycle.

vars.name: opacity-hi
vars.note: Peak opacity in breath/shimmer animations — the 'inhale' ceiling. Should be >= opacity-body.

vars.name: opacity-lo
vars.note: Trough opacity in grad-shimmer stop animation — the subtle fade at gradient tail. Should be < opacity-body.

vars.name: pulse-flow
vars.note: Duration of color-stop animate cycle on grad-flow and grad-shimmer gradients. Controls hue cycling speed.

vars.name: pulse-shimmer
vars.note: Duration of opacity pulse on grad-shimmer stop-opacity — independently tunable from color cycle.

vars.name: pulse-body
vars.note: Duration of opacity breath on Path 3 (body form). Slow living pulse effect.

vars.name: drift-sweep
vars.note: Full rotation period (seconds) of the grad-flow gradient transform animateTransform. Controls how slowly the hue wash rotates across all three paths.
